comment: Demo runs for FreeFlux non-rigid editing (ICCV 2025, wtybest/FreeFlux). Both prompts share the same seeded random latents — no source image or inversion needed. n_steps=50 and layer_idx match the paper notebook.

runs.name: bird_fly
runs.source_prompt: a bird perched on a branch
runs.target_prompt: a bird flying from the branch

runs.name: cat_lie_down
runs.source_prompt: a cat sitting on a wooden floor
runs.target_prompt: a cat lying down on a wooden floor

runs.name: dog_turn_head
runs.source_prompt: a yellow dog looking at the camera
runs.target_prompt: a yellow dog looking to the side

runs.name: person_sitting_standing
runs.source_prompt: a person sitting on a chair
runs.target_prompt: a person standing up from a chair
